items.text: Diane M. Harris is a retired employee of Commonwealth Edison, where she worked for over 30 years. She served as an IBEW union steward. She runs a small business and serves as a trustee of both Joliet Junior College and the Joliet Public Library.

sentences.text: Diane M. Harris is a retired employee of Commonwealth Edison, where she worked for over 30 years.
She served as an IBEW union steward.
She runs a small business and serves as a trustee of both Joliet Junior College and the Joliet Public Library.

items.text: Her campaign proposes improving customer service at the DMV. She proposes installing self-service kiosks in all 102 counties and deploying mobile units statewide. She says people should not have to make appointments for services that should be available at any time. She wants to cut fees for seniors and veterans and review the office's $885 million budget for waste and fraud. She says drivers should have a choice on whether to use digital licenses.

items.text: She supports the federal SAVE Act, which would require proof of citizenship to register to vote. She promises to clean up voter rolls and promote election integrity. She believes the office should follow state laws on license plate readers. She favors driver testing for all age groups. She proposes strengthening cybersecurity to protect personal data.
